notes: Pont-Neuf in Toulouse: seven unequal open masonry arches, six cutwater piers with through shield-like flood openings, warm brick spandrels and vaults, radial pale stone arch rings and relief-hole frames, stepped pier bases, continuous capped parapets, road/cycle/outer-walk surfaces, sixteen curved lamp standards with open scrolls and fourteen plain navigation diamonds. Fixed 134 m model datum, approximate end decks near143.5/145.5 m and gentle146.1 m central crown. Standard review water samples 134.638 m. Arch profile, relief opening, steelwork and submerged foundation dimensions are picture-guided exterior approximations; elevations are standard-viewer fitting controls, not a survey.
